title.zh: DIY儿童帐篷杆连接支撑件
title.en: DIY Kids Fort Rod Support Connector

summary.zh:
这是一款用于儿童DIY帐篷拼搭结构的连接支撑配件，主要材质为PP，适合与帐篷杆、连接件组合使用，支持多种拼搭结构扩展。

品牌为尧顺，产地东莞茶山，型号123D，适用于14岁以下塑胶玩具相关场景。
summary.en:
This is a structural support connector component for kids DIY fort building systems. It is mainly made of PP and is designed to work with rods and joint parts for multiple construction extensions.

Brand: Yaoshun. Origin: Chashan, Dongguan. Model: 123D. It is categorized under plastic toys for under-14 use scenarios.

zh: 该款DIY儿童帐篷杆连接支撑件为拼搭结构配件，主要用于连接与固定帐篷杆件，帮助形成稳定的框架结构。PP材质具备轻量和耐用特性，便于批量配套与装配使用。
产品适用于家庭拼搭、教学活动和儿童益智互动场景，可作为帐篷类拼搭产品的标准化结构件。通过不同数量组合，可支持多种形态扩展和方案定制。
包装支持彩盒、OPP袋和手提礼盒等形式，便于面向不同渠道做差异化出货。配套规格信息清晰，适合长期供货与项目采购。
en: This DIY kids fort rod support connector is a structural accessory used to connect and stabilize rods in fort-building frames. The PP material offers lightweight handling and durability for bulk matching and assembly.

It is suitable for home construction play, classroom activities, and educational interaction scenarios, and can be used as a standardized component for fort-style building products. Different quantity combinations support multiple structure extensions.

Packaging options include color box, OPP bag, and carry gift box, making it suitable for differentiated channel fulfillment. Clear specification data supports long-term supply and project procurement.

value.zh: 情感、视觉、智力开发、动手动脑、抓握、感官、手眼协调、亲子交流、兴趣培养
value.en: Emotion, visual perception, cognitive development, hands-on skills, grasping, sensory training, hand-eye coordination, parent-child interaction, and interest cultivation
